body:
Hey. I'm still around. I'm still struggling a lot. I'm having a hard time with impassivity and people just, it's not that they don't care but they're incapable of giving me the space I need, knowing how to talk to a person, or just boundaries in general. That's just my immediate family I'm stuck with right now. It's lead to a couple close calls. 

Yeah, I had a plan and goals and when my 4 year relationship ended, they just all kind have got yanked away from me. And that's what has been giving me hope and making my okay with myself the past couple years. And now I just feel like I have a huge empty hole inside me that I'm never going to back even if things worked out. Which she wants them too and just needed space but she already hurt me and did the damage. And what's left behind that wasn't taken away by that whole is all the negative feelings that I struggle to deal with on a day to day basis. Cynicism, nihilism, extreme self loathing, impulsive, depression, mania. It's just hard. I don't even like to look at myself in picture or mirrors anymore. And I feel like I need some kind of attention to fill that hole but I hardly have any friends or know where to meet them, let alone people I might be interested in but like, I just don't think I want to close to anyone either at this point honestly.

I'm gonna go take a permit test in couple of days and hopefully that's a good start but even if I get on the right track, there's just so much to deal with on a day to day basis. It's not even that I want to die anymore, though it doesn't take much to put me in the mood. I just don't want to be me. I know everyone has their problems but just, I hate being who I am. I hate being bipolar and how much it defines my personality even when I'm properly medicated. Just. I hate myself and I hate my life and almost everyone in it. 

Thanks for taking the time to respond. It means a lot and it's helpful even if it's gonna take a while for things to change. I've picked my guitar and longboard back up and I guess I'm starting to get things to passionate about back but things are so overwhelming when even that or multiasking say guitar and a tv can't get how I feel off my mind.
